snippet.title: Forge Talk 11: SDCC Round Up & More
snippet.description:
Jon-Paul Dumont and Bradley Fulton discuss the upcoming Beorn DLC, recount their trip to SDCC, the latest news about the new story expansion "Durin's Folk"
